title: Co-area formula on M for Borel weights
statement: Let N, m, k ∈ ℕ. Let M ⊆ ℝᴺ be an (m+k)-dimensional C¹ Simon submanifold that is a Borel set, U ⊆ ℝᴺ open with M ⊆ U, and f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ of class C¹ on U. Assume (hT): for all V ⊆ ℝ^{m+k}, W ⊆ ℝᴺ and ψ : ℝ^{m+k} → ℝᴺ with IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ, and every x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = range Dψ(x). Let g : ℝᴺ → [0,∞] be Borel measurable. Then y ↦ ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{y}} g dμHE[k] is Lᵐ-a.e.-measurable, and ∫_M g·coareaJacobian M f dμHE[m+k] = ∫_{ℝᵐ} ∫_{M∩f⁻¹{y}} g dμHE[k] dLᵐ(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (N m k : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (g : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn (m + k)) 1 M → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → (∀ (V : Set (Rn (m + k))) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → MeasurableSet M → Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun y ↦ ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, g x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ x in M, g x * ENNReal.ofReal (coareaJacobian M f x) ∂μHE[m + k] = ∫⁻ y, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}, g x ∂μHE[k] ∂volume
